title: Record cost and inference events for every harness run
narrative: Finance asks Nubble whether a harness run actually burned billable units. He runs a short one-shot job and checks the event log. He needs both an inference event and a cost event with non-zero units — the same signals he would forward to billing or a Grafana panel. If those events are missing, operations is flying blind. If they are present, he trusts the ledger enough to alert on it.
implementation: Kind `pass_through`. `PassThroughHarness` with scripted or OpenAI-compat inference emits `core:inference` and `core:cost` on `InMemoryEventLog`. Cassette twins under `openai_compat/*/v1` replay HTTP. Soft expects: both event types present with non-zero cost units.
